text: In these rooms of glass and color, a feeling of anticipation hangs in the air. The sterile arrangement of chairs and the technology on display spark a curiosity within me. I am surrounded by the intentions of innovation and collaboration. Yet, the stark cleanliness and the rigidity of lines evoke a subtle distance—am I merely an observer, or am I invited to participate? The energy is both inviting and slightly impersonal, encouraging me to reflect on the barriers and possibilities that exist within constructed spaces.
